matches.summary: UK developers who released games, apps or content on the Google Play Store between August 2018 and July 2026 can now claim for their share of a £260 million settlement agreed in a class action suit earlier this year.
matches.title: UK mobile developers can now apply for their share of a £260 million Google settlement

matches.summary: Rockstar has announced that GTA 6 achieved $3.79 billion in retail sales in its first day on sale, "setting a new record for entertainment across any medium, and becoming the biggest entertainment launch in history."
matches.title: GTA 6 hits $3.79 billion in its first day on sale, becoming "the biggest entertainment launch in history"

matches.summary: Over two million Xbox players in the UK and US accessed Grand Theft Auto 6 before its official launch by changing their location to New Zealand, according to Ampere Analysis.
matches.title: Ampere Analysis: Over 2m UK and US Xbox players accessed GTA 6 before official launch by switching location to New Zealand

matches.summary: Sensor Tower estimates Grand Theft Auto 6 sold over 24.5 million copies through pre-orders and on launch day, generating approximately $2.36 billion in revenue.
matches.title: Sensor Tower estimates GTA 6 generated $2.36bn in pre-order and launch-day sales

matches.summary: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced increased Ubisoft's Q2 net bookings to €389 million, exceeding the estimated guidance of €370 million.
matches.title: Ubisoft merges two Creative Houses as H1 results decline 16.5%; Q2 net bookings above guidance thanks to Assassin's Creed Black Flag remake
